[Rating: 4/10] Based on 1 play with 2 players:  Eh. It's beautiful, but lacks both player interaction and any kind of interesting puzzle. I'm fine with multiplayer solitaire, but the game either needs to have the width or depth (or both) to leave me always feeling like I have new things to try next time. There's not really much in the way of combo-building here.  I love mancala so I had high hopes for this but... sadly there are too many games so if something hits THIS poorly on its first go, I'm not interested in expending the effort to mine for hidden depths.

[Rating: 5/10] A neat attempt to make a mancala card game. Unfortunately, it's just dull.  You manipulate your cards and discs to be in the right place to take advantage of your card effects, but the card effects are all basic and there are only so many different ones. So you end up just doing the same thing over and over until the game ends.  I like the look of the game, and the game play isn't awful, but it's not something I would choose to play again.

[Rating: 5.5/10] Interesting design, lovely art - played on BGA. It just feels unintuitive and the council adds complexity that we avoided the entire game. Was excited for this one, but don't feel the need to play again.

[Rating: 6/10] Combines tableau building with a mancala mechanic.  The card abilities are not always all that exciting but the overall game has interesting choices and options.   I do like that you an take seeds from anywhere when buying a new card for your tableau which can help set up your next turn.  I haven't played yet where someone did any attacking but I could see that being somewhat annoying - there are cards that can minimize the effect and if a player keeps at least two columns balanced they do get to choose which one is affected.  In all, I'd be curious to explore this more.
